766700101.text: Lyylikki, how have things gone for you lately?

766700102.text: Ah! Hello, Lady Lauma. Everything's been going smoothly here.

766700103.text: The supply of ingredients has been steady, no one's causing trouble, and my cooking skills have really improved!

766700104.text: Oh, by the way, about those "friends" you mentioned last time... Were you talking about those animals?

766700105.text: They're so well-behaved and just quietly watch the people in line. I tried offering them something to eat, but they wouldn't take it...

766700106.text: Those little ones understand their duties. When they're on shift, they stay focused and hold to their posts.

766700107.text: Still, once they're off duty, feel free to give them a little treat. Hehe, I'm sure they'd be delighted.

766700108.text: Great! Then I'll make something delicious today to show my thanks.

766700109.text: Thank you, Lyylikki. If you need any help, just let me know.

766700110.text: No need, really! I've got it all under control — and besides, Mr. Kantor and Miss Jahoda are helping out.

766700111.text: Alright, I'll leave you to it. See you later, Lyylikki.

766700112.text: Ah, I should go bring out the next round of dishes... Oh, Lady Lauma, would you like to try this plate as well? It's freshly made — just came off the stove!

766700113.text: Alright, now to plate the food... Huh? Where are the plates I just washed...
